name: app-property-cards-with-3d-buildings-and-tilted-tablet-dashboard
title: Two light property cards with 3D building models, and a tilted tablet dashboard with a gradient bar chart
whatItIs: A board 'UI Design 04' with two white property cards for a studio and a flat, each with address, status tag, spec pills, a 3D isometric building and purchase and appreciation figures in light numerals; and a tilted tablet dashboard with greeting, next payout card, allocation bars, payout history with hatched and lime bars, and property cards.
whatItMeans: Tangible and calm; 3D buildings connect numbers to real assets.
techniques: Show each asset as a 3D building.
Use hatched bars with one lime bar.
Present components flat and in a tilted dashboard.

vocabulary.definition: A 3D building rendered from an angle.
A small label like Under Renovation.
A capsule listing a property attribute.
A bar filled with diagonal lines.
